# Process native ownership audit

## Immutable scope and provenance

Baseline: `3099c94fb1b6697907b43861a9fd507404f66c53` on `master`.
Guidance: `miyako/skills`, `4d-skills/skills/4dplugin/SKILL.md`,
`e6b492fcb81e5e1a7f7db723594b420e63bf6eb9`, read through the immutable
GitHub contents API, without another checkout.

The bundled engine implementation identifies itself as **v14**, whereas the
public API and Flags headers say **v13**. These mixed comments are not a verified
upstream release identifier.
The host test hashes each of these complete, unchanged Git blobs before compiling:

| Path under `4D Plugin API/` | Baseline Git blob |
|---|---|
| `4DPluginAPI.c` | `478081f0238f6bc5393222f574bc2656f010b67b` |
| `4DPluginAPI.h` | `9054b45ffc7ff6f5b8d57529a3788a55d977b314` |
| `EntryPoints.h` | `730f2f77ff2713fb2fe4b7d6562baeedf5f664cb` |
| `Flags.h` | `10a83185333dac06a62dda61b9f9428243d1e2ee` |
| `PrivateTypes.h` | `77053dc0c0a3718d2d3b6f158371a6af78c6ae66` |
| `PublicTypes.h` | `2bb392e73e9c556c274fe0a75b3a6b83e310b77c` |
| `4DPluginAPI.def` | `996ecc4ab11ad165de9192eba2e7478db141c757` |

No engine, ABI, export, manifest, project, resource, binary, or release workflow
was changed. The new `CommandArguments.h` is plugin-owned wrapper logic, included
from an existing compiled translation unit; it does not require project edits.

## Exhaustive tracked native/build inventory

`git ls-files` identifies one SDK, one dispatcher, and 16 wrapper implementations.
There is no second native source tree under the lowercase `process/`, tracked
`build/`, or packaged `.bundle` paths. Those paths contain generated records,
prebuilt binaries/resources, and 4D database/project material, not another native
implementation. Their presence is recorded, not used as proof of ownership safety;
the prebuilt binaries are neither tested nor regenerated by this audit.

Both `Process.vcxproj` (`ClCompile`) and
`Process.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` (`PBXSourcesBuildPhase`) compile
`4DPlugin.cpp`, the complete `4DPluginAPI.c`, and **all** of these `.cpp` files
under `4D Plugin API/Classes/`, including helpers unused by current commands:

| Implementations (each has a corresponding `.h`) | Ownership surface |
|---|---|
| `ARRAY_TEXT` | Borrowed descriptors copied into C++ strings; independent owner per output slot |
| `ARRAY_BOOLEAN`, `ARRAY_DATE`, `ARRAY_INTEGER` | Value arrays; shared SDK handle/resize boundary |
| `ARRAY_LONGINT`, `ARRAY_REAL`, `ARRAY_TIME` | Value arrays; shared SDK handle/resize boundary |
| `C_TEXT` | Input copy, content-setting parameter/return, UTF-8/UTF-16 and Cocoa helpers |
| `C_PICTURE` | Picture retention, path/format scalar arguments, command results, metadata, native image helpers |
| `C_POINTER` | Borrowed pointer block; owning value lookup and reference descriptor output |
| `C_BLOB` | `CBytes`/`C_BLOB` handle handoffs, hex/base64 through independently stored text |
| `C_DATE`, `C_INTEGER`, `C_LONGINT`, `C_REAL`, `C_TIME` | Scalar values, no string owners |

Other tracked native headers are `Classes/C_TYPES.h`, the six SDK headers in the
provenance table, `4DPlugin.h`, and `4D Plugin_Prefix.pch` (Carbon import).
`4DPluginAPI.def` exports `FourDPackex`; the full engine routes to `PluginMain`
and then `CommandDispatcher`. No private helper translation unit was excluded
because it lacks a public command.

Build metadata inspected: `Process.sln`, `Process.vcxproj`,
`Process.vcxproj.filters`, the Xcode project and its
`xcuserdata/miyako.xcuserdatad/xcschemes/Process.xcscheme`. The Windows project
lists all 18 native translation units with no custom pre/post-build command.
Xcode's Deployment shell phase performs signing, ZIP/DMG creation, notarization,
and stapling. The scheme's launch/profile/archive configurations select
Deployment. **No project build was run.**

The existing `.github/workflows/release.yml` and `bump-version.yml`, their
`.github/scripts/release.py`, `source_version.py`, and `bump-hooks/pre-push`
were inspected. Both existing workflows are manual-only. The new Ownership
workflow runs only the unsigned host test, with relevant path filters and exact
`miyako-process-ownership-audit`/`master` push branches plus pull requests.
It does not call either release helper or project build system.

## Every public command and internal string path

The root `manifest.json` and packaged
`Process.4dbase/Plugins/Process.bundle/Contents/Resources/manifest.json` agree:

| Selector | Manifest syntax | Actual data path |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `PROCESS GET ARGUMENTS(&Y)` | `ARRAY_TEXT`; independent copies of platform UTF-16 arguments |
| 2 | `PROCESS SET VARIABLE(&T;&T)` | Two `C_TEXT` input copies; synchronous environment setter |
| 3 | `PROCESS GET VARIABLE(&T;&T)` | `C_TEXT` input; copy environment result then content-set output |
| 4 | `PROCESS GET LIST(&Y;&Y;&Y)` | Two `ARRAY_TEXT` outputs and `ARRAY_LONGINT` IDs (third `Y` is generic array notation) |
| 5 | `PROCESS Get id:L` | `C_LONGINT` only |

Both platform branches were traced. Windows uses command-line arguments,
environment APIs, Toolhelp snapshots/modules and process ID; macOS uses
`NSProcessInfo`, environment functions, `NSWorkspace` application records and
Carbon process ID. There is no string callback or allocation alias shared
between these command outputs. Platform buffers/objects are consumed before
their releases. Windows snapshot/module handles are separately closed.
This static trace is not Windows execution evidence.

The internal scalar/array/callback paths in `C_TEXT`, `ARRAY_TEXT`, `C_BLOB`,
`C_PICTURE`, and `C_POINTER` were included even where the manifest does not
expose them. Searching for object/collection property/value APIs found no such
surface in the wrappers or this bundled API. The `PA_VariableKind` definitions and
actual wrapper calls corroborate that absence. Object/collection balance is
reported as **not applicable**, not simulated by inventing newer SDK APIs.
Dialog "object" names in the legacy SDK mean UI objects, not owning modern
object/collection values.

## Exact target contracts and fixes

Line references here refer to the immutable baseline `4DPluginAPI.c`.

| API / lines | Contract and caller consequence |
|---|---|
| `PA_CreateUnistring` 244-249 | Engine creation of a caller owner; null-terminated UTF-16 input |
| `PA_DisposeUnistring` 252-261 | Disposes buffer and zeros only the supplied descriptor, not other aliases |
| `PA_SetUnistring` 263-270 | Engine content setter; used by `C_TEXT` outputs, not struct transfer |
| `PA_CreateVariable` 3523-3657 | String/picture kinds allocate empty owners; Undefined does not |
| `PA_GetPictureVariable` 3729-3737 | Explicitly borrowed; retain before clearing its owning variable |
| `PA_SetStringVariable` 3825-3831 | Shallow assignment, no disposal of existing content |
| `PA_SetPictureVariable` 3852-3857 | Shallow assignment, no retain/dispose |
| `PA_ResizeArray` 3973-4137 | Disposes removed text slots; logical count changes even after failed physical resize |
| `PA_GetStringInArray` 4267-4281 | Borrowed slot; copy content before replacement/resize/clear |
| `PA_SetStringInArray` 4444-4460 | Accepted assignment disposes old slot and transfers supplied owner |
| `PA_ConvertCharsetToCharset` 4776-4792 | Input/capacity/result lengths are **bytes**, result excludes terminator |
| `PA_ExecuteCommandByID` 5257-5290 | Temporary pointer handle; success returns a variable owner; failure can return raw kind 0 |

Array acceptance predicates are exact: `eVK_ArrayUnicode`, non-null data handle,
`0 <= index <= fNbElements`, non-null input descriptor. Index **zero is valid**.
A null descriptor, absent handle, wrong kind, negative or excessive index does
not transfer. `ARRAY_TEXT` already allocates each output independently and does
not post-dispose accepted owners. Its input makes C++ content copies before
mutation. No mechanical array cleanup removal was necessary.

`C_TEXT` likewise already copies input and content-sets output; it does not
alias a disposed local `PA_Unistring`. The synchronous Process environment call
uses independently stored UTF-8/UTF-16 C++ values.

Confirmed shared-wrapper corrections:

- `fromFileAtPath`: start the path variable Undefined, transfer once, retain
  the output picture into the wrapper before argument cleanup; remove the
  second path disposal and clean the owning picture output.
- `setBytes`: release the temporary creation owner after the wrapper retains it;
  check creation error before adopting unspecified failure output.
- `createCopy`: divide converter result bytes by `sizeof(PA_Unichar)` before
  constructing `CUTF16String`. Check conversion error first. Avoid initialized
  empty string/picture overwrite leaks.
- All five picture command helpers: own arguments through `CommandArguments`,
  clear successful command return owners (including unexpected returned kinds),
  check error before any failure-result kind/adoption/cleanup. Retain borrowed
  input pictures for owning arguments and retain returned pictures before
  clearing those arguments. Returned copy/gray/thumbnail pictures remain
  independently caller-owned.
- `C_POINTER::getVariable`: check lookup error before reading output; clear the
  successful owning getter result after copying the existing reference
  descriptor fields. Its reference-descriptor construction behavior is otherwise
  unchanged; this is not certification of its legacy metadata interpretation.

`PA_GetPointerValue`'s owning-result cleanup requirement is explicit in the
bundled `4DPluginAPI.h:409`. Failure data is not established as an owner. In
particular, `PA_GetVariableKind` normalizes raw type 0 to string; checking kind
first is not a valid command-error test.

## Executed evidence

Run on macOS, with the system compiler, no 4D host:

```sh
python3 .github/tests/test_ownership.py -v
```

Local run: macOS 26.7 (25G229), arm64, Apple clang 21.0.0
(`clang-2100.1.1.101`).

The harness compiles the **actual dispatcher, all 16 actual wrappers, and the
entire unchanged SDK**, not copied method bodies or SDK fragments.
`ownership_platform.h` is force-included before every translation unit:
process info/workspace, URL/image, environment and Carbon process APIs are
redirected to synthetic stubs. The linked binary's undefined imports are
checked for forbidden original boundaries **before execution**. Unexpected
engine selectors fail closed. No process enumeration, applications, environment
access, process ID query, shell launch, private data, or actual host command is
used by the plugin fixtures.

ASan and UBSan are enabled, with UBSan alignment disabled for this SDK's packed
ABI structs. LeakSanitizer is disabled because Cocoa runtime allocations are
outside the model; explicit string allocations, picture retain counts and SDK
handles must all finish at **zero** on every passing leaf.

The same final harness was run against immutable `git archive` baseline sources
using `OWNERSHIP_SOURCE_ROOT`; test files always come from the fixed worktree.

| Named group | Leaves | Baseline pass / fail | Fixed pass / fail |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Actual five-selector dispatcher, both empty representations | 10 | 10 / 0 | 10 / 0 |
| Array transfers/copy/churn/replacement/shrink/clear/rejection | 2 | 2 / 0 | 2 / 0 |
| Scalar content setter and independent output lifetime | 8 | 8 / 0 | 8 / 0 |
| SDK failure predicates (not OOM certification) | 1 | 1 / 0 | 1 / 0 |
| Path/copy ASCII, BMP, supplementary, empty; allocated/null empty | 16 | 0 / 16 | 16 / 0 |
| Picture creation, gray, size, thumbnail owners | 4 | 0 / 4 | 4 / 0 |
| Pointer owning lookup and poisoned failure output | 2 | 0 / 2 | 2 / 0 |
| Command-handle/command/conversion/creation failures | 12 | 0 / 12 | 12 / 0 |
| Successful command returns: Undefined/string/picture, five helpers | 15 | 0 / 15 | 15 / 0 |
| **Total** | **70** | **21 / 49** | **70 / 0** |

Baseline failures include `duplicate/unowned string disposal`, unbalanced
string/picture owners, missing surfaced failures, and ASan
`heap-buffer-overflow` inside the actual `createCopy` UTF-16 constructor.
ASCII copy reads twice the converted units. BMP/supplementary fixtures also
exercise the byte/unit distinction and exact output length/content assertions.
The host returns byte counts faithfully; it does not change the conversion
contract to make the old caller pass. Capacity includes space for a terminator;
returned content length does not.

The synthetic dispatcher asserts exact argument/list content (including index
zero and surrogate pairs), IDs, environment copy independence, and stub control
counts: arguments 2, environment set/get 2, list 4, process ID 2. Array output is
read after allocator churn and replaced repeatedly; rejected insertions retain
the caller owner for cleanup.

The host/guard design was adapted from immutable `miyako/4d-plugin-ping`
`95bd88353008cf9ca212bae362ce3ea6fa271b95` files; Process API hashes, platform
boundaries, dispatcher fixtures and measured counts are target-specific.

## Concrete limits and deferrals

- **OOM is not certified.** The exact SDK resize failure test demonstrates
  physical storage unchanged while logical count becomes 7. It repairs only the
  synthetic descriptor for cleanup. The void wrapper and SDK expose no safe
  failure-preserving boundary after shrink disposal/resize mutation; no global
  SDK rewrite or empty-success fallback was introduced. Creation/retain and
  constructor OOM, allocation exceptions, and corrupt host descriptors remain
  outside the supported evidence. `PA_CreateUnistring` does not publish an error
  through `sErrorCode`, so stale-error checks cannot establish creation success.
- **Picture metadata ownership remains ambiguous.** The bundled
  `PA_GetPictureData` comments specify format enumeration but not successful
  metadata lifetime. The shim tests terminal error with poisoned output, not a
  guessed owning/borrowed success contract. `_GetCount`/`loadImageOfType`
  successful metadata ownership needs authoritative host evidence before edits.
- **No real Windows/4D execution.** Windows branches are inventoried and traced,
  but not compiled or run by this macOS harness. Real 4D command-return,
  picture/native-image behavior and platform API failures remain host-level
  validation tasks. No actual Windows crash or full 4D application scenario is
  claimed reproduced.
- All 16 wrappers compile; only the named ownership and dispatcher paths execute.
  BLOB conversion, unrelated scalar/value-array methods, legacy reference
  metadata interpretation and successful native-image rendering are not
  certified by this suite. Existing `PluginMain` catch-all behavior is unchanged.
